newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint firmed a shade against the dollar in afternoon trading, tracking the movements of the dollar/mark cross, and remained strong against the central bank currency basket, dealers said on Wednesday.
The forint finished at 180.80/85 to one dollar, compared with 180.88/93 both at midday and the opening.
The Hungarian currency remained pinned to the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid).
Dealers said a central bank rate hike three weeks ago, followed by upward corrections in government securities yields, made the forint attractive, pushing it to the NBH bid.
"We can see a lot of foreigners selling foreign currency and buying Hungarian papers, both fixed income and equity," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.
The forint was seen remaining at the NBH bid and tracking the dollar/mark in the near future.
The forint floats in the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
